summary: Phase X — period-based hours filtering for members & admins fully validated. Backend pytest: 27/27 passing (Me hours filters, Me hours/summary year rollup, Reports hours admin filters, Reports hours/summary group_by={member,chapter,overall,month,quarter,year}, chapter-scoped governor visibility, regression on /api/hours queue + PUT /api/hours/{id}/review). Frontend Playwright: all 5 admin filter selectors + 4 view tabs + hours-totals card present; By chapter/member/period/entries tables render with correct columns (verified 'Florida | 1 | 6.0h | 2' chapter row and 'Riley Chen | Florida | 6.0h | 2' member row); member /hours my-hours-year/my-hours-period selectors work, Q4 of 2026 shows empty state copy 'No hours in this period. Adjust the year/period filters, or log new hours.' as specified.

issues: Console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' originating from HoursReport — non-blocking; likely a missing key on one of the inline-rendered arrays (totals card sub-children or filter options). Worth a quick audit in Reports.jsx but does not affect functionality.
Recharts container warns 'width(-1) height(-1)' on initial mount on the Members reports view. Existed prior to Phase X — not a regression but flagged for future polish.

action_items: Optional: silence the 'unique key prop' React warning in Reports.jsx HoursReport — verify all .map() iterations have stable keys (totals tiles, filter Select children, etc.).
All Phase X spec items pass — main agent may proceed to next phase.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _period_to_range cleanly maps year/quarter/month to ISO Z-suffixed date range with monthrange for last-day-of-month — verified Q2 2025 → 2025-04-01T00:00:00Z..2025-06-30T23:59:59Z.

/api/me/hours/summary correctly defaults year to datetime.utcnow().year (verified test_summary_default_year returns 2026 in Jan 2026 env). by_month length=12 always (Jan..Dec) even when 0 entries; by_quarter length=4 with labels Q1..Q4. total_approved == sum(by_month.approved_hours) (within 0.01 tolerance).

/api/reports/hours/summary group_by={member,chapter,overall,month,quarter,year} all return spec-compliant row shapes. group_by=month rows are ASC sorted by period_key (verified). group_by=chapter computes member_count via set() of user_ids per chapter — correct. 'Unassigned' bucket created when a member has no chapter_id.

Admin gating: /api/reports/hours and /reports/hours/summary use admin_tab_dep('reports') — member returns 403 as expected. Chapter-scoped governor (governor.tx) sees only their chapter's hours (verified by intersecting user_ids).
/api/hours/{id}/review is a PUT (not POST). Spec mentions 'review' route gates pending→approved — verified PUT exists; POST returns 405 (correct routing).

Hours.jsx my-hours-period Select offers Entire year + Q1-Q4 + Jan-Dec (17 options). Builds URLSearchParams with year + quarter|month and refetches on change. Empty-state copy: 'No hours in this period. Adjust the year/period filters, or log new hours.' matches spec.

Reports.jsx HoursReport: minor — console emits a React 'unique key' warning when toggling view tabs. Functionality unaffected but should be cleaned up; review the .map calls for totals tiles (4 stat cards) and Select options.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Existing 2 approved hour entries (6.0h Florida chapter, Riley Chen) + 1 rejected entry sufficient to validate all group_by views. No data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase X coverage: /app/backend/tests/test_phase_x.py (27 tests, all passing). Covers /me/hours period filters (6 tests), /me/hours/summary year rollup (4 tests incl. zero-data year 2099 → total_approved=0.0), /reports/hours admin filters (7: list/member-403/summary-403/year/quarter/chapter/combined), /reports/hours/summary group_by all 6 variants + period window verification (7 tests), governor chapter scoping (1 test asserts no hour leaks outside chapter), regression on /api/hours queue + PUT /api/hours/{id}/review (2 tests). Frontend selectors confirmed working: my-hours-filters, my-hours-year, my-hours-period, my-hours-empty (copy 'No hours in this period…'), stat-approved/pending/entries, hours-filter-{year,period,chapter,status,type}, hours-view-{entries,by-member,by-chapter,by-period}, hours-totals, hours-report-run, hours-report-csv, hours-by-{member,chapter,period}-row-* — all verified at admin route /admin → admin-tab-reports → reports-tab-hours.
